title: Chronological in a Year
description: The whole Bible in the order the events happened, read through in a year. The arrangement is George Townsend's — his Old Testament of 1821, built on the chronicle of John Lightfoot of the Westminster Assembly, then his New Testament of 1826 — so Job stands among the patriarchs, Chronicles is woven into Samuel and Kings, each prophet is read in the reign he preached in, the psalms sit beside the occasions that produced them, and the four Gospels are harmonised into one life of Christ. The days are this app's own division of his order into 365 roughly equal readings.
